role: author proposal; reporter-based transcriptional inference, not direct-binding evidence

edge.subject: UniProtKB:Q88JX7
edge.description: Positive transcriptional regulation of the galb promoter/gene context is inferred from the KT2440 RFP reporter comparison. The promoter PP_RS13150 was assayed on pIK002_T versus pIK002A_T: 45/248-fold induction with the extra-copy construct versus 1.7/6.3-fold with the promoter-only vector in LB/MM, measured 6 h after 1.25 mM gallic acid in the source experiment. The promoter-only host retains its endogenous galR; the comparison is an additional plasmid copy, not a galR-null rescue. This does not directly measure native target-gene RNA, exact promoter occupancy, GalR ligand binding, or GalB/GalT protein activation. The reference GalR sequence is independently grounded; the exact 2023 plasmid insert was not sequenced here.

evidence.source_locator: PMC9942251 XML body paragraph ordinal 10 (zero-based 9), GalR/promoter results; Figure 2B and Supplementary Figure S2 establish reporter context.

endpoint_qualifiers.description: GalR supplied in an additional plasmid copy in P. putida KT2440, with PP_RS13150-RFP on pIK002_T; the promoter-only pIK002A_T control retains endogenous GalR. Readout: 6 h after 1.25 mM gallate in LB/MM. Native target-gene transcription and direct GalR binding were not measured.
